transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with an intense, overwhelming fear of animals, especially dogs. It has become so severe that it is really disrupting my daily life, and I need help finding a way to deal with it.
Is your anxiety limited specifically to being around dogs, or do you find yourself feeling constantly worried and tense about many different areas of your life in general?

My extreme anxiety is definitely limited to dogs and other animals. I don't feel constantly worried or tense about other areas of my life at all. It is really just the thought or sight of them that completely panics me.

latest_inference.note: The patient explicitly stated that their anxiety is limited to animals (specifically dogs) and denied having generalized worry or tension in other areas of life. This makes Generalized Anxiety Disorder unlikely, leaving Specific Phobia as the primary candidate.
